description: This file defines the StorageBackend class which implements the ISyncBackend interface for handling file storage synchronization, including creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving notes stored as files in a document tree URI, with support for validation and permission checks.

classes.name: StorageBackend
classes.description: Implements file storage synchronization backend using Android's DocumentFile API, managing notes as files within a document tree URI, with methods for CRUD operations, validation, and permission handling.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the storage location is accessible and permissions are granted, returning an AvailabilityStatus.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note file in the storage location and returns a SyncNote object.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note file with new content, possibly renaming the file.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note file from storage.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a note as a SyncNote object based on its storage URI.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all note files in the storage location.

methods.name: validateConfig
methods.description: Validates the storage configuration and permissions.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Converts a DocumentFile to a SyncNote object.

methods.name: getRootDocumentFile
methods.description: Retrieves the root DocumentFile from the storage URI.

methods.name: hasPermissionsAt
methods.description: Checks if the app has read/write permissions at the specified URI.

methods.name: writeNoteToFile
methods.description: Writes note content to a DocumentFile.

methods.name: getTitleFromUri
methods.description: Extracts the title from a file URI, removing extension.

methods.name: renameFile
methods.description: Renames a file within the root directory.

methods.name: inStorage
methods.description: Executes a block of code with timing and exception handling, returning the result or null.
